apps.summary: The smallest complete MCP App: an interactive card that shows the current server time with a UI-triggered refresh.
apps.samplePrompt: Show me the current server time using the interactive app.
apps.dataNote: Live server clock only; no external data and no stored state.

apps.summary: An editable startup budget with sliders, charts, historical trends, and stage benchmarks that recalculates as you adjust it.
apps.samplePrompt: Create a $1 million seed-stage budget I can adjust interactively.
apps.dataNote: Synthetic demo data generated on the server; nothing is persisted.

apps.summary: A dense interactive customer-retention heatmap over synthetic monthly cohorts with metric and period controls.
apps.samplePrompt: Show me an interactive customer-retention cohort heatmap.
apps.dataNote: Synthetic demo data regenerated per request; bounded cohort and period counts.

apps.summary: Explore 250 synthetic customers by segment, revenue, engagement, and NPS with interactive filtering and charts.
apps.samplePrompt: Let me explore customers by revenue and engagement.
apps.dataNote: Deterministic seeded synthetic dataset; identical on every call and instance.

apps.summary: Compare SaaS financial scenario templates and model custom 12-month projections with sliders and charts.
apps.samplePrompt: Compare a bootstrapped plan with a venture-funded growth plan.
apps.dataNote: Synthetic scenario templates computed on the server with clamped numeric inputs.

apps.summary: A live speech-transcription card built on the browser's Web Speech API, with copy-to-clipboard for the captured text.
apps.samplePrompt: Open a live speech transcription app I can dictate into.
apps.dataNote: Speech recognition runs in your browser via the Web Speech API (the host asks for microphone permission); no audio or transcript reaches the gallery server.
